sketches.mechanism: LEFT JOIN with NULL — a join where one side has no matching row, leaving all columns NULL
sketches.resonance: You reach for someone who was supposed to be there, and every field comes back empty.
sketches.draft:
SELECT self.name, other.name
FROM   people self
LEFT JOIN people other
  ON self.id = other.beloved
WHERE  other.name IS NULL;

sketches.mechanism: A query that fails to unify — Prolog's closed-world assumption means what cannot be proven true is false
sketches.resonance: You ask whether you are loved, and the silence itself is the answer.
sketches.draft:
loved(sun, earth).
loved(earth, moon).

?- loved(_, me).

sketches.mechanism: The 'never' return type — a function typed as never cannot return, it must diverge or throw
sketches.resonance: A promise that, by its very type, guarantees it will never be fulfilled.
